scope: Separate compiled durable reward worker, opt-in external dispatch and bounded trusted retry controls; no deployment or capacity qualification

source.scope: Final application/test source and documentation; later verification report/checkpoint only. Initial WIP runs have separately retained outcomes; worker-qualified and full-check cover this application source.

compiledRuntime.scope: Compiled API runtime graph only; installed external internals and contracts supplied by frozen workspace build; not a complete image/registry digest or SBOM

implementation: Shared ProgressionLedger and canonical account-lock port; API/focus/correction adapters retained. Four moved method bodies and all reward SQL unchanged.
Worker has independent pool/lifecycle with no HTTP/socket/session bootstrap; static runtime graph enforces the dependency boundary.
Per-batch read-only checksum/schema validation; default strict policy, known compatible expansion only via existing image-bound policy.
Worker batches/retries use the existing durable outbox/account locks/consumer receipt. Explicit bounded policy default30 and1..30 valid; legacy API constructor unchanged.
At most20 undelivered quarantine metadata rows; retry requires event/consumer/observed attempts/observed due time and does not clear a completed receipt. No browser/admin control endpoint.
API keeps room-bound maintenance; explicit worker role skips only periodic outbox drain. Both processes must use the same immutable policy; no automatic handover or global policy-hash registry.
Normal integration gate builds API before compiled process tests; worker command and boundary check implemented before claiming their results.

sourcePreservation.scope: Source preservation, not a proof replacing actual correctness tests

retainedFailures.label: retry-cas-before

limitations: Actual source/compiled Node processes and disposable local PostgreSQL; no new image/registry/hosted/cluster/staging/public/store qualification. Compiled graph hash is not a complete container digest/SBOM.

Real SIGKILL-at-COMMIT observed committed effects/receipt despite missing client ACK. The test allows the atomic rollback alternative and resolves both through retry; no universal commit-after-kill guarantee.
Worker defaults require explicit enabled policy/role; current real API defaults remain disabled progression and in-process legacy dispatch. No production worker is activated.

API and worker policy/role coherence is deployment-owned; no shared database policy-hash registry. Do not mix policies/legacy consumers during cutover; same-event effect/receipt uniqueness still guards duplicates.
CLI retry assumes trusted OS/DB access, has no MFA/admin audit or permanent operator-command idempotency ledger, and is not exposed remotely. N07/N08 own controls/alerts/freshness.
Completed batches may leave deferred/quarantined work; exit0/ready log is not queue health or sustainable capacity. Worker does not own room memory or a distributed fence.
Whole PG/server/network outages, SIGINT and additional crash boundaries are not independently certified worker process cases. Existing API recovery remains separately scoped.
Earlier WIP runs precede final legacy-default and retry timestamp refinements; worker-qualified and full-check apply to the final frozen application source. Initial failures retained.

No dependency or production-migration changes; room/safety/focus/travel source stays unchanged. No public/operator/adult/media release permission. N13/N14 inactive; hosted Deadline cadence/enforcement unresolved. Raw artifacts private local, not off-host archived.
